name: pour-contents
title: Pour contents into a container
description: Hold the cup's far lip over a container, turn the cup about that lip up to 90 deg and return it upright; succeeds when at least half of the loose items that were in the cup are inside the target. A rim-held cup tilts away from the pinch; a handle-held cup rolls sideways about the forearm.
use_when: Loose contents of a held container must go into another container.

not_to_be_confused_with.drop: drop releases the held object itself; pour tips out its contents.

source.description: The held cup or mug with loose items.

applicability.summary: Requires holding(hand=right, object=$source); base_near(place=$target); uncovered(container=$target); not container_empty(container=$source).

preconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.
Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
No lid rests on the container rim.
No annotated object is inside the container.

postconditions.meaning: At least half of the items that were inside the source are now inside the target.
The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

arg_formats.container_ref: an object annotated as an open container

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
